description: Free. Automated accessibility check of ONE public web page against WCAG 2.2 (desktop 1280 px + phone 320 px). Use it when the user asks whether their website or a page is accessible, meets WCAG / ADA / the European Accessibility Act, or what to fix for screen-reader, keyboard, contrast, zoom, form-label or alt-text problems - instead of guessing from the HTML. Input: the page's public address (https://...). Returns a plain summary, the most serious items with the WCAG criterion, who is affected, where on the page and how to fix it, plus the link to the same free check page. Takes 15-40 s; if it is not finished within about 40 s it returns status running + job_id: then call accessibility_result. Loads only the one page given (no crawling); private, local and non-web addresses are refused. Limits: 3 checks per client a day; counts as 1 call on the no-key trial, free with a key. Automated check, not a legal opinion. Example: {"url":"https://www.example.com"}.

url.description: Public address of the page to check, e.g. https://www.example.com or example.com/contact. One page per call.

wait_seconds.description: Optional: how long to wait for the result inside this call (default 40). 0 = return the job_id at once.

name: check_accessibility
title: Free website accessibility check (WCAG)
